items.title: Build AI-Powered Applications with MongoDB Atlas in Grok Build
items.summary: The rise of AI agents has fundamentally changed how software is built, with agentic platforms like Grok Build redefining the unit of software work. Instead of asking an AI assistant for a function, a developer or architect gives an autonomous agent a goal, constraints, a codebase, and a definition of done.
